title: Practice Match
html:
Quest Giver: Pwnston Practice Master

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Speak with the Pwnston Practice Master near the entrance to the practice PvP matches.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Pwnston Practice Master

Repeatable: No

Zone: Pwnston

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Speak with the Pwnston Practice Master near the entrance to the practice PvP matches.

Offer:

Practices matches are a good idea if you're new to Pwnston. Your group will be pitted against each either in a free for all. Seek Pwnston Practice Master, not too far from here, for he will allow you to enter practice matches.

Turn-in:

Practice makes perfect!

Level range: 1–100
